row.team_price_text: Essential: $45/month flat billed annually ($50 monthly), unlimited users
row.evidence: ProofHub's pricing page lists flat-priced Essential and Ultimate Control plans with no SSO or SCIM feature, and its help centre has users added manually or by "Import CSV" and signing in with email and password.
row.notes: New row. Flat pricing with unlimited users: Essential $45/month billed annually ($50 monthly); Ultimate Control $89/month billed annually for the first three months, then $135 ($99/$150 monthly), so per-user fields are null. No SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM or directory sync is documented on the pricing or security pages, the help centres or the API docs; people are added manually or via CSV import and can be suspended or deleted in the UI. The REST API v3 (X-API-KEY, documented on ProofHub's GitHub) can list, create, update and delete people and groups and list roles; the pricing card ticks API Access only on Ultimate Control (page markup), so api_tax is true. Okta OIN app is SWA only. None by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Essential
plans.price_text: $45/month flat billed annually ($50 monthly), unlimited users

plans.name: Ultimate Control
plans.price_text: $89/month flat billed annually for the first 3 months, then $135 ($99/$150 monthly), unlimited users

scim.notes: No SSO, SAML or SCIM appears on the pricing or security pages, in the three help-centre sitemaps (help.proofhub.com, /swift/, /plus/) or in the API v3 docs; login is email and password. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Per-user API key in the X-API-KEY header; a User-Agent header is required.

capabilities.notes: Role is set by role ID on create/update; suspension is a UI action with no documented API call.

endpoints.purpose: Add a person (first_name, last_name, email, role, language)

audit_log_api.notes: Activity logs exist in the app (advanced activity logs on Ultimate Control); no activity-log endpoint in the API v3 section list.

rate_limits.text: 25 requests per 10 seconds per account per IP; 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

okta.notes: OIN app (last updated Sep. 11 2019) ticks SWA only (page markup).

entra.notes: No ProofHub entry in the Entra SaaS tutorial index (toc.json).
